_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file). Lavalink, the standalone audio node Discord music bots connect to: Lavalink.jar from the official GitHub release (latest or a tag), checked against the SHA-256 digest the GitHub API lists (a release without one is refused), failures exit non-zero. application.yml is written once by the install (Lavalink's example, trimmed); the port and bind address are passed as Spring Boot arguments (--server.port, --server.address) and the password and source switches as Spring's environment names (LAVALINK_SERVER_PASSWORD, LAVALINK_SERVER_SOURCES_*), which override the file, so the password is never written to disk. The password is write-only (secret) and the start refuses to run without one. The heap (-Xmx) is a share of the server's memory, as in the Java App egg. Lavalink reads no console input; it stops on Ctrl+C. The start is Lavalink's ready line or the TCP port once bound.
name: Lavalink
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Lavalink: the audio node Discord music bots (discord.js, JDA, Red, Python bots) connect to for playback. Official release jar, checksum checked; your bot connects with the server address, port and the password set on the Startup tab.

startup_commands.Default: if [ -z "${LAVALINK_SERVER_PASSWORD}" ]; then echo '[Octail] Set Lavalink Password on the Startup tab: your bot connects with it.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f Lavalink.jar ]; then echo '[Octail] Lavalink.jar is missing: reinstall the server.'; exit 1; fi; exec java $([ "{{SERVER_MEMORY}}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && printf -- '-Xmx%sM' "$(( {{SERVER_MEMORY}} * {{HEAP_PERCENT}} / 100 ))") ${JAVA_ARGS} -jar Lavalink.jar --server.port={{SERVER_PORT}} --server.address=0.0.0.0

done: Lavalink is ready to accept connections

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Lavalink installation script (Octail's own): Lavalink.jar from the official GitHub release (latest or a tag), checked
# against the SHA-256 digest the GitHub API lists for it (a release without one is refused), failures exit non-zero.
# application.yml is written only when there is none; the port, the bind address, the password and the sources come
# from the Startup tab at every start and override it.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${LAVALINK_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/latest"
else
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi
if ! RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' "$API"); then
    echo "Installation failed: Lavalink release ${VERSION} wasn't found on GitHub."
    exit 1
fi
TAG=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.tag_name')
URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "Lavalink.jar") | .browser_download_url')
DIGEST=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "Lavalink.jar") | .digest // empty')
if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: release ${TAG} has no Lavalink.jar."
    exit 1
fi
case "$URL" in
    https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/download/*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: unexpected download address ${URL}."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
case "$DIGEST" in
    sha256:*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: GitHub lists no SHA-256 for Lavalink ${TAG} (only releases from mid-2025 on have one); pick a newer version."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "Installing Lavalink ${TAG} from ${URL}"
cd /mnt/server
if ! curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 -o Lavalink.jar.new "$URL"; then
    rm -f Lavalink.jar.new
    echo "Installation failed: Lavalink.jar couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${DIGEST#sha256:}  Lavalink.jar.new" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -f Lavalink.jar.new
    echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match the SHA-256 GitHub lists."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Checksum OK (SHA-256 from GitHub)."
mv -f Lavalink.jar.new Lavalink.jar
mkdir -p plugins logs

## application.yml only when there is none (Lavalink's example, trimmed): yours to edit, except what the Startup tab sets
if [ ! -f application.yml ]; then
    cat > application.yml <<'OCTAIL_EOF'
# Lavalink settings: https://lavalink.dev/configuration/
# Octail passes the port and the bind address (server.port, server.address), the password
# (LAVALINK_SERVER_PASSWORD) and the source switches (LAVALINK_SERVER_SOURCES_*) from the Startup tab at every start;
# they override the values below. Everything else here is yours: stop the server, edit, start.
server:
  port: 2333
  address: 0.0.0.0
  http2:
    enabled: false
plugins:
#  youtube: # settings of the YouTube plugin, see https://github.com/lavalink-devs/youtube-source#plugin
#    enabled: true
lavalink:
  plugins:
#    - dependency: "dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:VERSION" # downloaded into plugins/ at the next start
#      snapshot: false
  server:
    password: "" # set Lavalink Password on the Startup tab instead
    sources:
      # The built-in YouTube source is deprecated upstream: use the YouTube plugin above instead.
      youtube: false
      bandcamp: true
      soundcloud: true
      twitch: true
      vimeo: true
      nico: true
      http: false
      local: false
    filters:
      volume: true
      equalizer: true
      karaoke: true
      timescale: true
      tremolo: true
      vibrato: true
      distortion: true
      rotation: true
      channelMix: true
      lowPass: true
    nonAllocatingFrameBuffer: false
    bufferDurationMs: 400
    frameBufferDurationMs: 5000
    opusEncodingQuality: 10
    resamplingQuality: LOW
    trackStuckThresholdMs: 10000
    useSeekGhosting: true
    youtubePlaylistLoadLimit: 6
    playerUpdateInterval: 5
    youtubeSearchEnabled: true
    soundcloudSearchEnabled: true
    gc-warnings: true
    timeouts:
      connectTimeoutMs: 3000
      connectionRequestTimeoutMs: 3000
      socketTimeoutMs: 3000

metrics:
  prometheus:
    enabled: false
    endpoint: /metrics

logging:
  file:
    path: ./logs/
  level:
    root: INFO
    lavalink: INFO
  request:
    enabled: true
    includeClientInfo: true
    includeHeaders: false
    includeQueryString: true
    includePayload: true
    maxPayloadLength: 10000
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 100MB
      max-history: 7
OCTAIL_EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Lavalink ${TAG}."
echo "Set Lavalink Password on the Startup tab before the first start."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Lavalink Password
variables.description: The password your bot connects with (8-128 letters, digits and _ . @ # % + -). Required before the first start; never written to the server folder or shown again once set.

variables.name: Lavalink Version
variables.description: latest (the newest release on GitHub) or a release such as 4.2.2. Only releases with a SHA-256 on GitHub install (4.1.1 and newer). Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: HTTP Links
variables.description: 1: play any http(s) audio link a bot user sends. Off by default: it makes the server fetch any address it is given.

variables.name: Local Files
variables.description: 1: play audio files from the server folder.

variables.name: Heap Share
variables.description: The share of the server's memory given to the Java heap (-Xmx), in percent. The rest is left for the JVM and the audio buffers; lower it if the server is killed for memory.

variables.name: Java Options
variables.description: Extra JVM flags before -jar, such as -XX:+UseZGC.
